claim: For every construct in the declared grammar, conversion carries it, lowers it by a named rule, or refuses it by name. Silent loss, invention, fallback, and overwrite are forbidden.

roundTripInvariants.name: variant-space
roundTripInvariants.target: Every diffed component preserves its realized variant count and structured tuple set exactly, unless an explicit projection receipt authorizes a different set.

roundTripInvariants.name: nested-instance-identity
roundTripInvariants.target: A captured instance remains an instance and retains its instanceOf identity, or conversion refuses it by name.

roundTripInvariants.name: text-style-identity
roundTripInvariants.target: A named text style survives by identity, or conversion refuses the identity by name.

roundTripInvariants.name: deterministic-atomic
roundTripInvariants.target: Repeated conversion is byte-identical and any refused batch leaves every destination byte-identical.

roundTripInvariants.name: source-fact-conservation
roundTripInvariants.target: Every original fact is matched, diverged with a named class, or lost with a named class. Unclassified source facts are zero.

roundTripInvariants.name: no-unexplained-invention
roundTripInvariants.target: Every round-trip-only fact cites a declared normalization rule. Unclassified invented facts are zero.

normalizationRules.auto-layout-inert: A frame whose children are all absolutely positioned may acquire an inert auto-layout direction without changing rendering.
normalizationRules.cartesian-fill: A contract with independent axes emits the complete Cartesian product; strict exact mode refuses a ragged source instead of applying this rule.
normalizationRules.declared-not-drawn: The contract declares a property that the observed instance did not carry.
normalizationRules.duplicate-sibling-expansion: Repeated same-named source siblings share one normalized path while regenerated siblings receive numbered paths; every extra fact remains counted.
normalizationRules.hug-vs-fixed: Headless comparison cannot equate an observed hug measurement with a regenerated fixed or fill sizing mode.
normalizationRules.instance-ink-loss: Unresolved defect: a nested instance survives but its probed primary fill differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.instance-target-loss: Unresolved defect: a captured nested instance or instanceOf target returns as a non-instance or disappears.
normalizationRules.interaction-states: A canvas state axis was intentionally projected into bounded interaction previews rather than retained as an API axis.
normalizationRules.geometry-projection-loss: Unresolved defect: measured size, position, radius, arc, or fill sizing differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.layout-projection-loss: Unresolved defect: layout mode, alignment, sizing, or padding differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.layout-mode-derivative: A layout sub-fact remains counted but is dispositioned as derivative of an already-counted layout-mode change.
normalizationRules.mixed-stroke-weight: Figma reports per-side stroke weights as mixed, so a regenerated uniform weight has no source-side scalar.
normalizationRules.paint-effect-projection-loss: Unresolved defect: fill, stroke, or effect identity differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.restructured: The same value moved to a different named anatomy path; both the source loss and regenerated invention remain counted.
normalizationRules.structure-wrapper-invention: An introduced wrapper is an ancestor of a separately paired restructured node and cites that pair as evidence.
normalizationRules.shape-kind-loss: Unresolved defect: a captured parametric shape returns as a generic box or disappears.
normalizationRules.text-content-projection-loss: Unresolved defect: text content or raw typography differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.text-style-identity: Raw typography survived but a named text-style identity did not.
normalizationRules.url-image: An image or URL fill has no supported deterministic emitted asset projection.
normalizationRules.variant-projection-loss: Unresolved defect: a realized component-property value differs or disappears.
normalizationRules.vector-glyph: The headless mock cannot recover vector internals or instance primary ink.
normalizationRules.zero-fill: A rendering-neutral transparent solid explicitly carries the observed absence of a solid fill.
normalizationRules.zero-stroke: A rendering-neutral zero-width transparent stroke explicitly carries the observed absence of a stroke.

fidelity.metric: per-set mean of v2.1 canvas→code fidelity scores over scored variants
fidelity.policy: decrease-only floors: each set's current mean must stay at or above its baseline meanScore minus tolerance, and its scored-variant count must not shrink; floors are re-seeded only upward, by committing a higher meanScore after a real fidelity gain
